title: Shiftory agent-quality captured agent run provenance (v2)
description: Full provenance for one real agent capture. Supersedes v1, which conflated 'when capture_result read/ingested RAW_RESPONSE' with 'when the generating agent actually ran' -- for every capture in this repository generated via a copilot-cli task sub-agent (invocation.kind == 'copilot_task'), v1's started_at_utc/finished_at_utc were in fact microseconds apart, because they were only ever set around the bookkeeping read of an already-completed RAW_RESPONSE file, never around the actual generation, which took tens of seconds to minutes in a separate process this harness does not control or observe. v2 makes this honest: capture_ingested_at_utc is always the (accurately labeled) bookkeeping time; invocation.generation_started_at_utc/generation_finished_at_utc are only ever populated when genuinely observed (true only for invocation.kind == 'local_process', where this harness itself started and waited on the subprocess), and are null with a required reason otherwise -- never fabricated or silently defaulted to the ingestion time. isolation_method='protocol' means the generating agent's blindness to the rubric relies on the prompt package's contents and instructions, not on a sandbox that prevents reading the repository -- this schema forces that statement to be recorded explicitly rather than implied.

invocation.description: A tagged union. 'local_process' means this harness itself started and waited on a subprocess (agent_harness.run_capped_subprocess): argv/env/exit/stdout/stderr and real generation timing are all directly observed and required. 'copilot_task' means the generating agent ran as a Copilot CLI task sub-agent in a separate orchestrating conversation this harness never controlled or streamed output from: only what was actually configured/observed for that invocation is recorded, and real generation timing is null with an explicit reason unless it was genuinely captured from that sub-agent's own reported elapsed time.

capture_ingested_at_utc.description: When agent_harness.capture_result actually read RAW_RESPONSE and wrote this record -- always known, always distinct from generation timing, never presented as the latter.

engine_identity.description: What ran shiftory analyze/explain to produce the evidence this capture is based on. Never fabricated: verification_method states exactly how 'value' was established, and value is the literal string 'unknown' when it cannot honestly be determined.

benchmark_protocol_commit.description: The repository commit whose committed benchmarks/agent_quality/ tree defines the exact case/rubric/harness protocol this capture was generated under. 'verified' is true only when prompt_package_manifest's own recorded case.json sha256 (already hash-anchored to the real materialized package) is cross-checked by code against that commit's actual committed case.json bytes -- a cryptographic proof that the capture used the protocol version this commit defines, independent of and strictly stronger than any wall-clock ordering between the commit's timestamp and this capture's timestamps. When commit is null or verification cannot be performed, verified is false and note explains why.

migrated_from_v1_sha256.description: When this record was migrated from a v1 agent-run.json rather than produced fresh, the sha256 of that original v1 JSON bytes, so provenance history remains auditable across the schema migration.
